sourceSentences: Bel'Veth dashes in the designated direction, though not through terrain, dealing physical damage to enemies she passes through.
Void Surge can be cast only within a cardinal direction that is off cooldown, and incurs a cooldown between casts. Each cardinal direction has a unique cooldown.
Void Surge resets Bel'Veth's basic attack timer.
If this hits an enemy champion, it resets Void Surge dash cooldown of the target direction.
More than one cooldown can be reset if enemy champions were hit within multiple directions. The cooldowns that get reset are based on the relative direction to Bel'Veth at the end of the cast
Bel'Veth enters a frenzy for 1.5 seconds, during which she is unable to move, but gains damage reduction and life steal.
While active, she rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest current health percentage
Royal Maelstrom does not prioritize champions over other units.
Royal Maelstrom can be recast after 0.75 seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration or when Bel'Veth casts an ability.
Bel'Veth's ability casts grant her ghosting and 20% bonus attack speed for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts.

Bel'Veth dashes to the target Void Coral to consume it over the cast time, slowing nearby enemies by seconds elapsed for the duration. She then creates an explosion at the location to deal true damage to enemies within
True Form: Bel'Veth evolves into a monster, gaining bonus health, bonus attack range, increased size, as well as increased total attack speed. Void Surge can dash through terrain.
